notes.title: ✨ NEW COVER IS READY ✨ GETTING INSIDE RELEASE DATE - AUGUST 15 💓
notes.notes:
Hello, tamers!

The day has come: the official release date of ✨ Getting Inside ✨ is now available - the game will be released on August 15th!

Add ✨ Getting Inside ✨ to your wishlists right now and download the game the second it comes out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3478920/Getting_Inside_Hentai_Story/
